helpful: The provisioned petition and BIO text were the decisive inputs; the BIO's final-judgment and capable-of-repetition points are not visible from the docket alone.

gaps: No statpack cut conditioned on a Court-requested response after a waiver, which is the strongest signal on this docket and the one I had to price from memory.
